semantics.clock: Update on positive edge of clk, as explicitly specified for all DFFs.
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous reset: at each positive edge, reset=1 sets q to zero, with priority over d.
semantics.capture: At each positive edge with reset=0, q captures d with no additional latency.
semantics.hold: q holds between positive edges; reset changes alone do not update q.
semantics.initialization: Original problem provides no initialization requirement; no initializer is added and verification starts functional expectations after a clock edge.

numeric.data: All eight bits copied without arithmetic or signed interpretation.

verification.oracle: Derived directly from original positive-edge DFF and synchronous reset requirements.
verification.sampling: Drive away from rising edges and sample after nonblocking assignments settle.
cases: reset assertion and release between edges
verification.timeout: Bounded simulation with fatal on mismatches and PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up q is unspecified; no defined initial value is assumed.
Behavior for X/Z inputs is unspecified; functional stimulus uses binary values.
